statement: Let S be a smooth projective complex K3 surface. Suppose that there is a rational isometric embedding (TS, q) ,→ VP . For any full even-Clifford realization H1(A, Q) = C+(TS, q), any rational nonisotropic w ∈ TS, and any rational polarization E of this weight-one Hodge structure, there is a cycle ΓS ∈ CH2 (S × A × A)Q HODGE CONJECTURES ON A K3 QUADRATIC LOCUS 3 whose action on every x ∈ TS is exactly ιw,E(x) in H2(A × A, Q). The same assertion holds on a transported isogenous model with its specified tensor. Moreover, the rational Hodge conjecture and the rational generalized Hodge conjecture hold in every cohomological degree of every self-power Sm, for every integer m ≥ 1.
